title: Standardpotenziale und Nernst-Beziehung abrufen
titleEn: Recall standard potentials and the Nernst relation
description: Die lernende Person kann die Vorzeichendeutung von Standardpotenzialen und die auf der Karte begrenzte Nernst-Beziehung mit Reaktionsquotient und Aktivitätskonvention mithilfe der zugehörigen Lernkarten sicher abrufen.
descriptionEn: The learner can reliably recall the sign interpretation of standard potentials and the Nernst relation with reaction quotient and activity convention within the limits stated on the card using the associated flashcards.

memorySupportSelection.role: Recall of previously taught compact content only. No ordinary competency, source duty, acquisition performance, or Human evidence is certified.
memorySupportSelection.selectionSemantics: Unchanged getSrsFilterTags returns the existing goal: tags because no GK/LK or new selector tag is added. The unchanged card filter uses their OR intersection; actual ordered cards are checked, not inferred from selectedCardIds.
